name: alibabacloud-dms-mcp-server-inner

tools.name: getInstance
tools.description: Retrieve detailed instance information from DMS using the host and port.

host.description: The hostname of the database instance
host.title: Host

tools.name: searchDatabase
tools.description: Search and retrieve detailed information about databases registered in the DMS.

schema_name.description: Name of the database schema to search for.
schema_name.title: Schema Name

env_type.description: Environment type of the database, such as 'production', 'development', 'test', etc.
env_type.title: Env Type

db_type.description: Type of the database, such as 'MySQL', 'Redis', etc.
db_type.title: Db Type

tools.name: searchLogicDatabase
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about logic databases DMS.

tools.name: getDatabase
tools.description: Obtain detailed information about a specific database in DMS when the host and port are provided.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the database instance
host.title: Host

tools.name: listLogicTables
tools.description: Search for logic tables by databaseId and (optional) table name. If you don't know the logic databaseId, first use searchLogicDatabase to retrieve it.Note: searchLogicDatabase may return multiple logic databases. In this case, let the user choose which one to use.

search_name.description: Optional: Search keyword for table names
search_name.title: Search Name

tools.name: listTables
tools.description: Search for tables by databaseId and (optional) table name. If the user mentions a logical database or logical table, please use the tool with 'logic' in its name.If you don't know the databaseId, first use getDatabase to retrieve it.If you don't have enough information for getDatabase tool, ask the user to provide the necessary details.

search_name.description: Optional: Search keyword for table names
search_name.title: Search Name

tools.name: getTableDetailInfo
tools.description: Retrieve detailed metadata information about a specific database table including schema and index details. If you don't know the table_guid parameter, retrieve it using listTables.

tools.name: executeScript
tools.description: Execute SQL script against a database in DMS and return structured results.

database_id.description: Required DMS databaseId. Obtained via getDatabase tool
database_id.title: Database Id

logic.description: Whether to use logical execution mode
logic.title: Logic

tools.name: createDataChangeOrder
tools.description: Execute SQL changes through a data change order, and a corresponding order ID will be returned. Prefer using the executeScript tool for SQL execution; only use this tool when explicitly instructed to perform the operation via a order. If you don't know the databaseIds, first use getDatabase to retrieve them. You can pass multiple databaseIds to target multiple databases in a single order. If you don't have enough information for getDatabase tool, ask the user to provide the necessary details.

database_ids.description: Required list of DMS databaseIds. Obtained via getDatabase tool; you can pass multiple IDs to target multiple databases.
database_ids.title: Database Ids

logic.description: Whether to use logical execution mode
logic.title: Logic

comment.default: Data correct order submitted by MCP
comment.description: Business context for the data change order
comment.title: Comment

annotations.title: 在DMS中创建数据变更工单

tools.name: getOrderInfo
tools.description: Retrieve order information from DMS using the order ID.

tools.name: listSecurityColumns
tools.description: Retrieve the list of security columns under the table. If you don't know the table_guid parameter, retrieve it using listTables.

instructions: Database Management Assistant (DMS) is a toolkit designed to assist users in managing and interacting with databases.
